body: Could you test if this crash happens in Godot 4.5 and 4.4 stable?

it works in 4.5 (i didn't check 4.5.1) and 4.4(however Terrain3D plugin doesn't load in 4.4)
I can do more if someone tells me what to do or if it is easier we can do video call with screen sharing. That's the least I can do, but I failed to create MRP and it would be to hard for me to understand internals of Vulkan renderer and its implementation in Godot. If someone wants to take a stab at it let me know.

There some more test you can for now:

- Test Godot 4.7 dev 1 to check if still reproducible. You can download these and other versions [here](https://godotengine.org/download/archive/)
- If also crashes on 4.7 dev 1, test the versions between 4.5 stable and 4.6.1 stable to found where the crash started
- Run Godot with Vulkan validation layers in the console and check for errors. You can see how to setup and use them [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/development/debugging/vulkan/vulkan_validation_layers.html)
JFYI 4.7 still has this issue. I will try to locate commit where this was broken.

There is some sort of caching. same commit id wasn't failing, then failing and then not failing again. That's because I couldn't pinpoint exact commit through binary search. Once it started to reproduce I didn't find a commit that doesn't cause issues unless I start from the beginning. Any suggestions? I do binary search and ```git reset --hard; git checkout ab0a7f2da2; scons -j8 platform=windows arch=arm64 target=editor module_mono_enabled=yes dev_build=yes debug_symbols=yes; .\bin\godot.windows.editor.dev.arm64.mono.console.exe --headless --generate-mono-glue modules\mono\glue; py .\modules\mono\build_scripts\build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir=.\bin --godot-platform=windows; git -C "C:\Users\qweqe\Documents\project" reset --hard; .\bin\godot.windows.editor.dev.arm64.mono.console.exe --editor --path "C:\Users\qweqe\Documents\project" --rendering-driver vulkan --rendering-method forward_plus```

Oh I see why now. Some commits just don't compile which is unexpected... So I didn't really run it with every commit I tried. Surprisingly a lot of them do not compile. I will try to take another stab at it, but I don't think I will be able to find a specific commit because not all commits compile
